biological_reference.closest_mechanism: dorsolateral-PFC rule-coding neurons biasing premotor/striatal action selection (contextual gating).
dependencies: a credit signal bound to the state active at action time
biological_reference.divergence: LOAD-BEARING. The mechanism CLASS has a solid biological existence proof, but the TRAINING SIGNAL is a formal import: episode-level REINFORCE over a replay buffer in which every sampled tuple is scored at ONE shared end-of-episode lpfc.rule_state. Brains bind credit to the state active AT THE TIME OF THE ACTION (eligibility traces), never to a single current state. The biology therefore positively favours the F2 replay-mismatch rival over both pre-registered hypotheses, and names the repair: per-sample rule_state at update time IS the eligibility-trace analogue.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-09-11 governance, cycle gov-20260911-1612] V3-EXQ-1020 (SD-082 learning-signal probe, diagnostic PASS, indexer-flagged vacuous_pass; confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1020_2026-09-11): INCONCLUSIVE on both pre-registered legs, but it DID close the gap 822f could not. The in-run dense-synthetic-credit positive control learned its own task (+0.00223..+0.00327 held-out expected-reward gain, positive in 10/10 cells) and persisted (0.719-0.770), so a low-persistence reading here measures the real signal rather than a blind instrument. C1 (gradient present) passes but is a self-declared liveness check (floor 1e-6 vs measured 0.0059-0.0102). C2 (persistence below the in-run noise/positive-control midpoint) passes on a BARE MAJORITY and on the SAME three seeds in both arms (622/633/644; 611 and 655 sit above their midpoints in both). C3 (advantage negative on rule-driven flips) is UNADJUDICATED, NOT REJECTED: MIN_FLIP_SAMPLES=20 against a worst cell of 4 fresh-select flip samples, with only 4 of 10 cells eligible. The self-routed label H_learning_signal_noisy_supported therefore asserts more than the design carries -- the driver's own F2 red-team disposition records the replay/rule_state-mismatch rival as unexcluded and states verbatim 'Do NOT read a C2 PASS as establishing H-learning-signal-noisy over this rival'. Biology independently favours that rival: episode-level REINFORCE scoring every replayed sample at one shared end-of-episode rule_state has no biological analogue, where credit binds to the state active at action time. Routed to a four-leg fan-out portfolio; no substrate build owed. SD-082 stays candidate_substrate_landed.

driver_declaration_fix.fix: Declare interpretation.criteria_aggregation = "any" in the emitted manifest.
driver_declaration_fix.why: The driver's own combination_rule states C2 and C3 are 'reported INDEPENDENTLY ... NOT AND-ed', but criteria_aggregation is ABSENT from the manifest and the indexer defaults it to 'all'. Check (3b) at build_experiment_indexes.py:639-648 then fires vacuous_pass on any single load_bearing criterion that did not pass -- here C3. vacuous_pass is in BLOCKING_ADJUDICATIONS (:838, :859-861), so it blocks minting a substrate_queue entry or clearing a gate. Declaring 'any' is the indexer's own escape hatch and makes the driver's stated semantics machine-readable.

learning_extracted: The run ACHIEVED its stated purpose. 822f's blind-instrument/no-signal ambiguity is closed: the in-run positive control learned its own task (+0.00223..+0.00327 held-out expected-reward gain, POSITIVE in 10/10 cells) and persisted (0.719-0.770). A low-persistence reading here is a measurement of the real signal, not instrument blindness.

The vacuous_pass flag is a FALSE POSITIVE AT THE VERDICT LEVEL, but NOT by the route first drafted. The indexer's live rule is check (3b), build_experiment_indexes.py:639-648: load_bearing true AND passed false, with criteria_aggregation defaulting to 'all'; it returns before the legacy criteria_non_degenerate path. C3 fires it simply by being a load-bearing criterion that did not pass. The flag is a false positive because the driver's own combination_rule declares C2 and C3 NOT AND-ed, and the label routes at `elif c2_pass:` (driver:1427) without reading C3 -- but the manifest never declares criteria_aggregation, so the indexer cannot know that. See driver_declaration_fix.

C3 is UNADJUDICATED, NOT REJECTED. MIN_FLIP_SAMPLES=20 against a worst cell of 4 fresh-select flip samples; only 4 of 10 cells eligible (n = 4,4,8,9,16,17,29,42,52,61). That guard is the driver's own F4 red-team disposition, raised from `n_flip_samples > 0` precisely because the fresh-only count runs ~10x below the hold-weighted one. The design anticipated this failure and guarded it correctly; the budget did not deliver the samples.

C2 passes on a BARE MAJORITY and on the SAME three seeds in both arms (622, 633, 644); seeds 611 and 655 sit ABOVE their midpoints in both arms. seeds_required = 3 of 5. Independently recomputed from arm_results; the c2_midpoint equals (noise+synth)/2 exactly to 1e-12 in all 10 cells.

The self-route LABEL overstates what C2 licenses, and the driver says so itself: F2 records the rule_state-mismatch rival as unexcluded and states verbatim 'Do NOT read a C2 PASS as establishing H-learning-signal-noisy over this rival'. H_learning_signal_noisy_supported is a legitimate grid output whose plain-English name asserts more than the design can carry.

CONFIGURATION FACT, NOT A SD-082 FINDING (rewritten after the Step 7c red team; the first draft got this wrong). per_episode_returns are bit-identical between ARM_ON and ARM_OFF across all 5 seeds x 70 episodes. This is NOT evidence about SD-082's readout and NOT a fresh behavioural axis. (a) The swept variable is crf_cue_centering ALONE -- both arms hold train_rule_bias_head and rule_readout_consumer True and there is no head-ablated arm, so the null is about CRF centering, not about the head. (b) A behavioural difference was impossible by construction: use_modulatory_selection_authority is False (default, config.py:1273; never set by this driver) and bias_scale=0.1 is tanh-bounded, and config.py:1262-63 states verbatim that 'fixed small bias magnitudes (~0.05-0.1) added to primary scores whose raw_score_range is much larger never change the argmin'. (c) The de-replicated flip figures are n_fresh_flip_ticks 5->6 for seed 611, not the hold-weighted n_flip_ticks 49->57 the driver's own F4 disposition demotes. What this DOES establish, and it matters for successor design: any behavioural probe on this path is INERT until selection authority is enabled -- which is why the Step 8 gate added a constitution-axis leg to the portfolio.
